info.name: Pick-Drop Mobile APIs
info.description:
Collection for Parent, Self, and Driver mobile APIs.

Source of truth: routes/api.php (includes routes/driver.php + routes/parent.php).

Parent/Self register: a 6-digit email verification code is sent to the given email. Use POST .../email/verify with body {"code":"123456"} after login. With MAIL_MAILER=log, read the code from storage/logs/laravel.log.

Requests support service_type: both | pickup_only | drop_only and multi-stop via stops[].
Driver service-areas / profile support available_seats + availability_hours.
